5648b133987dLOWMissing Content-Security-Policy headerhttp://127.0.0.1:18082Security headersConfirmed vulnerabilityHighhttpcurl2026-11-15T22:32:43ZA05:2021 Security MisconfigurationNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.No CSP is set, so the browser has no policy limiting where scripts and other resources may load from, reducing defence against XSS.Browsers are not instructed to apply defence-in-depth protections, which makes exploitation of other flaws (XSS, clickjacking, downgrade attacks) easier.HTTP/1.1 200 OKServer: LabServer/1.2.3 Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 22:32:42 GMTContent-Type: text/htmlContent-Length: 196Connection: closeSet-Cookie: sid=<redacted>; Path=/Set-Cookie: pref=<redacted>; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=LaxX-Powered-By: PHP/5.6.40Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (avoid unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval).Severity is context dependent; static or non-sensitive sites may accept this risk.

64b9e3838993MEDIUMCookie without HttpOnly attributehttp://127.0.0.1:18082Session managementConfirmed vulnerabilityHighhttpcurl2026-11-15T22:32:43ZA07:2021 Identification and Authentication FailuresNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.Cookies without HttpOnly can be read by JavaScript and stolen through XSS.Session cookies may be exposed to script access or sent over insecure channels, increasing the risk of session theft.Cookie names (values not stored): sid Set the HttpOnly attribute on cookies that JavaScript does not need.Cookies used only for client-side preferences may legitimately omit HttpOnly.

3eb2c466eeebLOWCookie without SameSite attributehttp://127.0.0.1:18082Session managementConfirmed vulnerabilityHighhttpcurl2026-11-15T22:32:43ZA07:2021 Identification and Authentication FailuresNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.Without SameSite, cookies are sent on cross-site requests in older browsers, aiding CSRF.Session cookies may be exposed to script access or sent over insecure channels, increasing the risk of session theft.Cookie names (values not stored): sid Set SameSite=Lax or Strict (None only with Secure when required).Modern browsers default to Lax, reducing the practical risk.

b745b0abd299MEDIUMSite served only over unencrypted HTTPhttp://127.0.0.1:18082/Transport securityConfirmed vulnerabilityHighhttpcurl2026-11-15T22:32:43ZA02:2021 Cryptographic FailuresNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.No HTTPS service was found; all traffic, including any credentials, is sent in cleartext.Traffic may be intercepted or modified in transit, exposing credentials and user data.GET http://127.0.0.1:18082/ -> HTTP 200Deploy a valid TLS certificate, enable HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.Local lab targets commonly use plain HTTP.

fcdb10dc21a2HIGHCORS reflects arbitrary origin with credentialshttp://127.0.0.1:18082CORS misconfigurationPotential vulnerabilityMediumhttpcurl2026-11-15T22:32:43ZA01:2021 Broken Access ControlNot scored: no directly demonstrated impact, or insufficient evidence for a defensible CVSS vector.The server reflects an untrusted Origin and allows credentials, which can let malicious sites read authenticated responses.A malicious website may be able to read responses from this application in a victim browser.Origin: https://doxa-cors-test.invalid -> Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://doxa-cors-test.invalid; Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: trueValidate Origin against a strict allow-list; never reflect arbitrary origins with credentials.Impact depends on whether the endpoint returns sensitive, authenticated data.
